text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 2530001234 - Elevated fncall errors and streaming structured_output failures detected for hosted inference. Error rate 8% (>5% threshold). Paging oncall.
maria_oncall: I'm on it, pinging dom.
dom: here, grabbing traces and gateway logs. which routes are hot?
kevin_sre: /v1/generate-stream and /v1/agent/invoke showing high 500s from external agent connector. KV cache thrash and queue depth rising.
sara_prod: customers report long stalls when models attempt tool/function calls and when responses use structured JSON streaming. Impact: UX timeouts and increased errors.
maria_oncall: priority = reduce customer-facing failures quickly. Proposal: temporarily restrict function_call/tool invocation and structured_output streaming for non-paid plans (free/trial/dev) and apply gentle rate limits on dev tiers. Keep dedicated and enterprise unaffected.
dom: we can scope via feature flags and routing policy. Suggest a canary: apply to 5% of traffic in the plan bucket first, then ramp. Also provide a fallback mapping that turns structured JSON into plain-text summaries for streaming endpoints.
kevin_sre: agree. Also add per-tenant soft caps to bound bursts (token-bucket 50 qps) to stop queue blowups.
maria_oncall: dom please flip the flags and push the route caps. Communicate to support and status once we see improvement.
dom: executing now. command: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/api/flags/toggle \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"flag":"fncall.enabled","value":false,"scope":{"plans":["free","trial","dev"]},"canary":0.05}'
```
incident-bot: rollout started by dom at 2530001250 - canary 5% applied
kevin_sre: metrics: error-rate falling to 4.1% after 90s, tail latency improving. watching histogram.
maria_oncall: good. sam_support, please draft a short status update and canned reply for affected users outlining limited functionality. Use plain language and point to support for upgrades.
sam_support: drafted: "We're temporarily restricting agent/function calls and streaming structured outputs for free/trial/dev customers to mitigate elevated errors and latency. Dedicated customers are unaffected. We're monitoring and expect to restore shortly. Contact support for urgent needs or upgrade options." Want me to post?
sara_prod: post to status.redwood for 'partial degradation of agent/function features' and ping sales for potentially impacted leads.
kevin_sre: applied route-level token buckets on streaming endpoints: 
```
# route config
limits:
  streaming:
    per_tenant_qps: 50
    burst: 100
```
maria_oncall: set rollback criteria: error-rate <1% and 95p latency <200ms for 10 continuous minutes. dom add runbook note with traces.
dom: added runbook entry / pinned trace ids (abcd-1234, ef56-7890). Leaving ff canary at 5% while we monitor, will ramp to 100% for scoped plans if stable.
incident-bot: incident severity downgraded to P2 at 2530001560 (metrics improving)
maria_oncall: thanks all. next steps: postmortem owner? sara please own and include timeline, root cause, mitigation automation (auto-scale queue/backpressure) and customer impact list.
sara_prod: will own, scheduling a postmortem within 48h and will coordinate customer comms.
kevin_sre: monitoring window 30m. will update if any regression.
maria_oncall: closing this coordination thread. follow up in postmortem and runbook. :white_check_mark:
